مقدمة
This document out lines Lube oil system maintenance 
procedure I1, which to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The System consists 
of R5502, GT 4033, R 1587, R 4591, R1586, R1588, R5201, R5205, 5206, R5210 GT 
4031.
The first draft initiated 
 by eng. Mohmed Aly Aly 
Hassan, tested at 01 Jan. 2003 by eng. 
 الشحات Ahmed Mousa,
 reviewed by eng. 
 Abd Almonem Alemam,
 revised by quality 
 control engineer, accepted by General Manger eng. Hamdy Melegy 
 ووافق عليها المهندس يسري محمد علي سلامة الشباب رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء الشباب.
احتياطات السلامة
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
Gas turbine should be out of service at cold state.
Oil pumps ( AC DC ) off ( All mcc. C.B Risk out)
